corrections.name: French Wiktionary
corrections.rule: A noun whose English Wiktionary gender category is the opposite of the single gender that the head line of each French noun section of the French Wiktionary gives, {{m}} or {{f}}. The candidates came from a comparison with Lexique 3.83 (CC BY-SA 4.0), whose data the file does not hold; each correction rests on the French Wiktionary entry of the word.
